subject: fire mage in a crimson hooded robe holding a gnarled staff topped with an ember crystal
motion: casting a fireball forward from the staff
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: an orange-and-yellow fireball with a flame trail leaving the staff tip

plan.source: Three-quarter to the right: left hand grips an upright gnarled staff with ember crystal, right arm extended forward, head looking right, wide stance with both feet planted.

frames.pose: Anticipation: shift weight back, torso leans left; left hand draws staff back/down beside hip; right arm retracts near chest, hand cupped; head dips toward crystal; left foot planted, right heel light.
frames.effect: Small orange-yellow sparks gather at crystal; faint glow at staff tip.

frames.pose: Key: drive weight forward; torso lunges right; left arm snaps staff forward-right, tip leading; right arm swings back for counter; head fixed on target; both feet planted, right foot pressing.
frames.effect: Orange-yellow fireball bursts from staff tip and shoots right with short flame trail; bright ember arc along the thrust path.

frames.pose: Follow-through: torso over front foot; left arm extended then starting to recoil downward; right hand floats forward open; head tracks the shot; both feet planted.
frames.effect: Fireball further right with trailing flame taper; a few sparks shed from the trail near the path.

frames.pose: Settle: torso returns upright; left hand brings staff back upright beside body; right arm extends forward, relaxing toward point; head forward; feet resettle to wide stance.
frames.effect: Trail fades to tiny embers near staff tip; no new projectile.
